data.value:
hromosome breakage analysis using diepoxybutane (DEB) and/or mitomycin C (MMC) induced chromosome breakage assay on peripheral blood lymphocytes.

------------------------------------------------------------
METHOD
------------------------------------------------------------

- Peripheral blood lymphocytes cultured with and without DEB/MMC exposure.
- Chromosome spreads prepared and examined under microscope.
- Chromosomal breaks, gaps, and radial figures counted.
- Control samples analyzed concurrently for comparison.

------------------------------------------------------------
RESULTS
------------------------------------------------------------

| Parameter                         | Value                       | Reference Range / Notes          |
|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|---------------------------------|
| Number of metaphases analyzed     | __________                  | Typically 20-50 metaphases       |
| Mean chromosome breaks per cell   |                             |                                 |
|   - Untreated control             | __________                  | <0.1 breaks/cell                 |
|   - DEB-treated                  | __________                  | <0.5 breaks/cell normal          |
|   - MMC-treated                  | __________                  | <0.5 breaks/cell normal          |
| Number of radial figures          | __________                  | Usually none in normal controls  |
| Percentage of cells with breaks   | __________%                 | <5% in normal controls           |

------------------------------------------------------------
INTERPRETATION
------------------------------------------------------------

[Example:]  
Significantly increased chromosome breakage and presence of radial figures in DEB/MMC treated cultures indicate positive test for Fanconi Anemia.
